evidence: Carries the P2P label, removes private broadcast coupling from src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp, and reimplements transaction relay via Tor/BIP324 background jobs.
rationale: Overhauls private transaction relay to eliminate shared node state that risks deanonymization and IP linkage. The author notes the change targets 'protecting against IP address linkage and not crashing the node on adversarial inputs', addressing what reviewers term an active privacy footgun in master while cleanly disentangling CConnman from special-case connection logic.
